status: Design-only. No runtime/default/rental changes; the ready precision wheel is untouched.
objective: An opt-in H3 producer that can be measured separately from attention precision, preserving Turbo8 four-dense/four-sparse policy, first2blocks/refiner, full Sage protected-prefix recomputation, LoRA effects and current-call statistics.

smallest_hook.api: MiniMaxH3Attention.set_processor on the particular attention instance
smallest_hook.existing_owner: internal/fusion_install.py:FusedMiniMaxH3AttnProcessor and _install_transformer already install per-instance processors after fill
smallest_hook.reason: The registered attention backend is called only after full Q/K/V projection/norm/RoPE. It is too late to avoid those tensors. Add a producer-aware processor under explicit selection; no global Diffusers monkeypatch.
smallest_hook.policy: Consult the existing attention layout/site before choosing production. Dense steps, refiner and configured dense paths delegate to the existing processor and Sage path unchanged.

confirmed_constraints.name: Current statistics require a replay or retained values
confirmed_constraints.evidence: Kitchen sol_attn_chunked(kmean=None,vscale=None) calls the projection factory twice: first collect current post-RoPE K sums and V maxima, then quantize. Passing an iterator instead materializes all chunks to replay.
confirmed_constraints.implication: No previous-call statistics need be used, but streaming current statistics is not a free one-pass projection. A one-projection-pass implementation must retain the K/V values needed after global reductions.

confirmed_constraints.name: V scale margin changes arithmetic
confirmed_constraints.evidence: Chunked API uses amax/127*1.1; plain sol_attn preprocess uses amax/127.
confirmed_constraints.implication: Expose/match margin explicitly (1.0 for parity with current plain Kitchen candidate). Do not call a changed scale policy fusion-only.

confirmed_constraints.name: Norm/RoPE rounding differs
confirmed_constraints.evidence: Runtime rounds BF16 norm, BF16 cos/sin, both rotary products and their sum. Kitchen producer rounds norm then combines rotary products in FP32 before final BF16 store.
confirmed_constraints.implication: Preserve Runtime rounding in a producer mode, or declare a separate numerical-preparation experiment. The existing stock producer is not bitwise interchangeable.

confirmed_constraints.name: Sage prefix still needs original BF16 K/V
confirmed_constraints.evidence: Runtime recomputes every protected query row with the common Sage dense callback against all live K/V. Kitchen sink_q computes dense rows with its INT8 kernel and block granularity.
confirmed_constraints.implication: Retain normalized BF16 K/V and prefix Q; do not silently substitute sink_q for Sage. Full elimination of BF16 K/V contradicts this unchanged boundary unless a new streaming Sage interface is added.

confirmed_constraints.name: Ulysses sits after projection today
confirmed_constraints.evidence: Diffusers H3 shards hidden states and rotary tables by sequence; processors see local sequence/all56heads. attention_ulysses exchanges projected QKV into global sequence/localheads. Kitchen producer expects global sequence/headlocal chunks.
confirmed_constraints.implication: Need bounded projection-chunk exchange plus global offsets/RoPE assembly. Rank boundaries need not be64aligned. A global hidden-state gather followed by full QKV projection on every rank would duplicate projection work and is not the intended solution.

confirmed_constraints.name: LoRA and encoded activation custody
confirmed_constraints.evidence: H3 Turbo has permanent _LoRAHook consumers and fixed4096-row LoRA accumulation; weights sets _cozy_baked as the live overlay is materialized. Fused input may be leaves.PreQuantized, which currently has no row-slicing API.
confirmed_constraints.implication: Call original to_q/to_k/to_v modules on chunks to preserve hooks and baked overlays. Do not slice raw weights or concatenate replacement linears. Add a view-only PreQuantized row slice for the unhooked path, preserving payload/scales and logical shape. Unknown stateful hooks require explicit handling/refusal.

proposed_correct_pipeline: Per-instance processor checks the shared dense policy; only eligible sparse calls enter producer mode.
Project local4096-token chunks through the original Q/K/V modules. Preserve existing LoRA4096-row padding/rounding and original-tensor operands when hooks require them.

Use the existing process group and all-to-all primitive to exchange projected chunks into headlocal global-token tiles. Carry explicit global offsets, reassemble64-token boundary fragments and preserve token order; do not pad the semantic document or change Sol neighbour/sink indices.
A producer measurement stage applies matching norm/RoPE rounding, quantizes Q immediately, retains normalized BF16 K/V and protected Q, and collects current K sums/V maxima. No prior-call statistics.

Finalize current statistics with a declared reduction/scale policy; quantize retained K/V into the existing Kitchen workspace and run the existing Sol core. Margin1.0 matches the plain current-statistics baseline.
Recompute protected rows through the unchanged Sage dense callback using retained BF16 K/V, then reuse the existing inverse Ulysses output exchange and original to_out modules.
Record producer backend, statistics policy, scale margin, protected-row backend and replay count independently from the INT8 precision label.

upstream_api_needed.producer_workspace: An explicit workspace/producer API accepting global token offsets and post-norm retention outputs; current Python sol_attn_chunked accepts only sequential contiguous chunks. Low-level _C.sol_producer_chunk already has t0 but exposes no retained normalized BF16 K/V.
upstream_api_needed.prepare_modes: Current-statistics measure/finalize stages, selectable scale margin and a Runtime-compatible norm/RoPE rounding mode; reuse existing Sol core rather than create another attention framework.

scope_estimate: A single-GPU replay adapter might be150-220lines, but does not satisfy the4GPU/matched-Sage/rounding constraints by itself. A faithful prototype is approximately300-600lines of Runtime processor/communication integration plus100-250lines of producer/API work and dedicated tests. Estimate only; not implemented in this bounded pass.
validation: CPU original-module chunking with armed and baked Turbo hooks; encoded activation row-slice byte/scale preservation.
Compare materialized and producer preparation with the SAME precision, current-statistics policy, V margin and rounding contract.
Real unequal-shard2/4/7/8 exchange tests, including64-token boundary fragments, padding poison and no token reorder.
Rented tiny-kernel admission through CozyCLI before full action samples; compare bytes/error, peak buffers, projection count and stage timings.
Full15s same-seed Turbo4/4 action pair. Previous-call statistics reuse stays a separate opt-in approximation and measurement.
